As a first time supplier shipping equipment to support one of the major Australian infrastructure project I came up against uncharted territories. It was a three months discovery and mobilization period until the first shipment left its origin airborne for Melbourne. Looking back I really appreciate Chris effort in helping a potential customer to understand what are required and how to go about the execution. Our first time right delivery to my Customer's 3PL was no coincident. It was Chris' relentless attention to details and pro-active monitoring of the process that ensured a smooth dock to dock delivery. I would like to offer Chris my most sincere congratulation in his new venture with United Carriers.

I worked closely with Chris over several years to build a seamless, cost effective supply chain for one of Australia's s largest fashion retail companies. Chris' knowledge and passion for the industry was apparent from day one. As anyone who works in logistics understands, your freight parter is more than just a service provider, they are an integral part of your business. Chris was not only able to help us streamline our operations throughout Asia and shorten our time to market, but through his willingness to negotiate great rates on our behalf, also provide significant cost savings. For anyone looking for a freight agent who is always available and ready to assist in anyway possible, then I cannot recommend Chris Lebon and United Carriers any higher. ‍

faq.question: What does United Carriers do?
faq.answer: United Carriers is a global freight forwarding and logistics provider delivering end-to-end supply chain solutions, including airfreight, seafreight, customs brokerage, warehousing, and transport.

faq.question: What industries do you specialise in?
faq.answer: We support a broad range of industries including retail, fashion, food & beverage, industrial, project cargo, and technology.

faq.question: What shipping methods do you offer?
faq.answer: We offer airfreight, seafreight (FCL & LCL), breakbulk, RO/RO, and multimodal transport solutions.

faq.question: Do you provide customs clearance services?
faq.answer: Yes, we offer in-house customs brokerage to manage import and export clearances efficiently.

faq.question: How is freight pricing calculated?
faq.answer: Pricing depends on factors such as shipment size, weight, origin, destination, mode of transport, and current market conditions.

faq.question: Do you offer warehousing and 3PL services?
faq.answer: Yes, we provide storage, pick and pack, inventory management, and distribution solutions.

faq.question: Can you handle oversized or heavy cargo?
faq.answer: Yes, we specialise in project cargo including out-of-gauge (OOG) and heavy lift shipments.

faq.question: How do I request a quote?
faq.answer: You can contact us via our website, email, or phone with your shipment details.
